summary: Credicorp Ltd. filed Form 6-K furnishing its 2Q26 earnings release. The report covers consolidated financial results, including net income of S/1,981.9 million, ROE of 20.3%, loan growth of 13.1% YoY, deposit growth of 17.7%, NIM of 6.63%, and NPL ratio of 4.1%. No corporate action, transaction, or special situation is disclosed. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, with no strategic event, M&A activity, or capital markets transaction.
